title: Vijayanagara founding: more legends, rulers, sources

boxes.title: Founding: added detail
items: Crowned at the ==**Virupaksha** temple==; kingdom "in the name of Sri Virupaksha"
Legend: a ==**hare** turned on royal hunting dogs== → place of valour
**Giri Durga** on **Ramadurga** hill; **14 x 10** miles; some notes: entered **1344**
Brothers visited Sringeri **1346** after Hoysala victory

boxes.title: Origin: more versions
head: Version
Point
rows: Sent vs **Prolaya Nayaka**, **Prolaya Vema**; met Vidyaranya near ==**Pampa**==
Saluva: **Kalyani**; Tuluva: Tuluva region; Aravidu: ==**Araviti**==, Kurnool
Some: **Tuluva Narasa Nayaka**; son crowned **1505** after executing **Immadi Narasimha**

boxes.title: Sangama rulers: more
head: Ruler
Added point
rows: **Rajavyasa, Rajavalmiki**; **Irugappa**: Ganigitti Jain temple, *Navaratnamala*; famine "**Durgadevi Karamu**"
Daughter to **Firoz Shah Bahmani**; ==first to recruit Muslims== (CDX); Kandukuru Reddis feudatories
**Kondaveedu 1424**; Sri Lanka tribute via ==**Lakkanna Dandanayaka**==; **Mallappa Odayar**, Draksharama **1444**

boxes.title: Madurai, scholars, Saluva
items: **Kumara Kampana** took Madurai **1352-53** (⚠ some: beat **Sambhuvaraya** **1366**); **Saluva Mangu** = "Parapakshi Saluva"
Gangadevi: disciple of **Agastya**; defeat of ==**Champaraya**== of Tondaimandalam
Devaraya II: *Mahanataka Sudhanidhi*; Srinatha beat ==**Gauda Dindima**==
Saluva Narasimha: lord of **Chandragiri**; repelled Bahmani raid on **Kanchi** (**1481**)

boxes.title: More exam points
items: Mudgal war: Bukka; truce to spare civilians; **Nehal** of Mudgal
Other foundations: **Nagalapuram** (Krishnadeva Raya, mother **Nagala Devi**); **Nauraspur** (Ibrahim Adil Shah II)
